title: Find actions and edit sliders from a keyboard command palette
source: rapidroom (original implementation with Codex; interaction ideas from pdcgomes/redlamp command-palette design)
notes: Ctrl+K opens searchable application actions and schema-backed numeric controls with Lightroom aliases, typed values and crop ratios. Shortcuts and palette share guarded action handlers. Arrow-key slider and local-preset previews revert on Escape; confirmation creates one undoable edit. Focus is restored and stale photo/edit previews are discarded. Default adjustment values and image-rendering algorithms are unchanged.
